anchors: Corrosion effects can be accurately predicted when the environment is consistent over the test period.
meaning_zh: 试片法准确预测腐蚀效果以整个试验期环境一致为条件。

source_witnesses.text:

                      test period.

anchors: Common sensors will be acceptable for any functions other than shutdown functions and automatic start/changeover of the required pumps
meaning_zh: 共用传感器的许可不适用于停机功能和所列必需泵的自动启动/切换。

source_witnesses.text:
Common sensors will be acceptable for
                 any functions other than shutdown functions and automatic start/changeover of the required
                 pumps

anchors: Stop the pump (set) immediately.
Eliminate the causes before returning the pump set to service.
meaning_zh: 异常时立即停泵；重新投运之前须消除原因，不能拆成无前后关系的独立建议。

source_witnesses.text: Eliminate the causes before returning the pump set to service.

anchors: For safety reasons the pump is only allowed to operate against closed discharge valve for a short time (max. 5 minutes and at a max. temperature of 80 °C for standard pumps).
meaning_zh: 标准泵闭出口运行的许可同时受最长5分钟、最高80°C约束；不据此提供现场操作授权。

source_witnesses.text:
For safety reasons the pump is only allowed to operate against closed discharge valve for a short
                                                                                  
      time (max. 5 minutes and at a max. temperature of 80 °C for standard pumps).

anchors: No holes or screen openings on the motor bracket can be covered by insulation.
meaning_zh: 保温时不得覆盖电机支架孔或网罩开口；不能表示成正向覆盖建议。

source_witnesses.text:
No holes or screen openings on the motor
     bracket can be covered by insulation.

Vibration trip level
meaning_zh: DESMI建议电机非驱动端振动跳机阈值为>15 mm/s，需保留测点、量纲与适用范围。

Make sure that flow is increased or a smaller pump is used
meaning_zh: 对应表格情形的措施为增加流量或使用较小泵，是替代方案，不是两项必做。

anchors: Ispezionare le facce delle tenute verificando che non siano usurate e controllare le condizioni degli elastomeri. Sostituirle se necessario oppure prenderne nota per la manutenzione programmata.
meaning_zh: 检查密封面磨损与弹性体状态，必要时替换，或记录以安排维护；保留条件与替代分支。

witnesses.text: Ispezionare le facce delle tenute verificando che non siano

anchors: Before attempting toopenor service the pump:
Allow the pump to completely cool if overheated.
meaning_zh: 检修/开泵前，若已过热应先完全冷却；不是任何工况都必须冷却的无条件建议。

witnesses.text: Before attempting toopenor service the
pump:

if overheated.

anchors: Operation of the pump under conditions differing widely from those, on which the pump selection was based, may result in cavitation or shortened life of bearings, seals, packing, and shaft.
meaning_zh: 偏离选型依据的工况可能造成汽蚀或部件寿命缩短，需保留工况和可能性。

source_witnesses.text:
Operation of the pump under conditions differing widely from those, on
       which the pump selection was based, may result in cavitation or shortened life of bearings,
       seals, packing, and shaft.

Daily flushing out dirt

source_witnesses.text: Flow straigheners are for clear liquids applications only.
